instagram.author: sarahrosenborg
instagram.body:
🌎👇🏽THESE ARE MY TOP RESOURCES: 

1. UGC Content (My main income + the most beginner-friendly)

Brands pay me to create content for them! Not to post on my page🫣🚀 it can be photos, TikTok-style videos, demos or just including the product / service in my daily travel lifestyle ~ they buy the content + ad usage rights. They even pay for all kinds of bonuses like: 

1. Exclusivity 1️⃣
2. Raw files 📹
3. Licensing rights 📢

💸 You can earn $300 - $500 per video starting out and with two retainer clients, that’s already $1K/month secured.

🎥 All you need is your phone, basic editing skills, and a good pitch.

If you want me to teach you UGC from scratch, comment UGC and I’ll send you everything. 💌

⸻

2. Affiliate Income (No need to be “influencer-level”)

I share links to apps, travel gear, booking sites I genuinely use.. if someone books through my link, I earn a commission📈💰

✨ Perfect if you don’t want brand deals but still want passive income.
✨ Some programs pay 10–30% or a flat fee per signup.

Try platforms like Travelpayouts, Worldpackers, Booking.com affiliates, Amazon influencers.

⸻

3. Freelance Skills = Freedom 🦋

Photography, video editing, social media management, email copywriting ~ pick one and offer it to businesses online✍🏽🎬

Work per project, from anywhere in the world. Great if you want reliable monthly income.

⸻

You don’t need to “go viral” to make money online. You just need a skill + Wi-Fi. If you want me to teach you UGC from scratch, comment UGC and I’ll send you everything💌

#travel #ugc #ugccreator #contentcreator #travelcreator
